content: Supabase forgot-password flow: (1) call supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, { redirectTo: '<app-url>/admin/reset-password' }); (2) the emailed link redirects to that route with a recovery session; (3) client listens for the PASSWORD_RECOVERY auth event (or reads the session established by the redirect) and shows a new-password form that calls supabase.auth.updateUser({ password }). The redirect URL must be added to Supabase Auth's URL Configuration allow-list or the redirect is rejected.
